critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin only accepts email; a phone-only non-admin user cannot hit the 'This login is for admins only' branch from the UI (input type=email forces '@'). The role-check branch is code-only-triggerable. Consider allowing phone OR email input on the admin page too, or explicitly noting admin login requires email.
server.py at 1417 lines — still a monolith. Consider splitting into routers (auth/deposit/withdrawal/paynow/admin) as codebase grows.
The /admin/deposits/{id}/verify endpoint hard-codes status_code==2 as 'paid'. Consider a small helper mapping PayNow codes to internal states for maintainability.
reconcile_pending_paynow_deposits/withdrawals iterate up to 200 items at a time — a comment noting the cap would be helpful.
